planned_holds.what: the finished saved-reply card, after line 05

shots.move: one sentence types itself into a card; copies of it stack up the frame as the camera pulls back

scenes.title: Every day
scenes.hand_off: the stack of cards shrinks and becomes one grey card in a queue

shots.focal_point: the empty reply box on the lowest card
shots.move: a queue of question cards slides in; the reply box stays empty, cursor blinking

scenes.title: Write it once
scenes.hand_off: the blinking cursor becomes the edge of a saved-reply card

shots.move: title types in on a card edge, push in
one answer types out and folds into a labelled card
question cards arrive again; each lights the same card; hold once on the finished card

shots.focal_point: the card sliding toward a reply box
shots.move: card is found in a short list and drops into the reply box, slow and calm

shots.focal_point: the one word that changes, then the send arrow
shots.move: one word is edited, the send arrow clears the question; the queue shortens card by card
shots.sound: two steady hits, one per phrase

scenes.title: New in your inbox
scenes.hand_off: the cleared queue becomes the logo mark

shots.text:
Saved replies.
New in your support inbox.
shots.move: calm field, logo mark opens, text rises
